title: Save to Vaultix browser handoff, version 1
description: Messages exchanged with window.postMessage between an allow-listed partner page (the opener) and the Vaultix popup at <SITE_URL>/integrations/save-secret. The partner opens the popup with the query described by $defs/request (never in an iframe). Vaultix posts ready, the partner posts one value, Vaultix stores it with the signed-in person's own session and posts one result. Every message goes to targetOrigin = the validated request origin; Vaultix accepts a value only when event.origin equals that origin and event.source is window.opener. The value is never in the URL and is never posted back. See docs/0125-save-to-vaultix-handoff.md.

nonce.description: One-time request identifier chosen by the partner: 22 to 43 base64url characters, at least 128 random bits. It correlates the messages of one handoff; it is not a credential.

kind.description: What the partner is handing over. Shown to the person and recorded in the secret comment.

origin.description: An exact origin as window.location.origin writes it: https, or plain http on loopback only. It must appear verbatim in the operator's VAULTIX_INTEGRATION_ORIGINS.

request.description: Query parameters of <SITE_URL>/integrations/save-secret, all strings. Unknown or repeated parameters make Vaultix refuse the request; a value parameter is never accepted. On any failure Vaultix shows an error page and posts nothing.

source.description: Partner application identifier, for display. Nomen sends "nomen".

name.description: Suggested secret name. Vaultix trims it, replaces whitespace, colons and slashes with underscores, caps it at 255 characters and lets the person edit it.

readyMessage.description: Vaultix to opener, once, after the person is signed in and the page is ready to receive the value.

valueMessage.description: Opener to Vaultix, once, after ready. Vaultix keeps the first valid one in memory only and ignores every other message. The value must be at most 65536 bytes of UTF-8; maxLength here counts characters and is exact for ASCII.

resultMessage.description: Vaultix to opener, exactly once per ready. fulfilled: stored, with the secret name and version. approval: a change request waits for the project's approval policy. declined: the person cancelled or closed the window without a failed save. error: a save was attempted and failed, and the person stopped. A partner must also treat the popup closing without a result as declined.
